test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Some features of villi of the small intestine in humans are given below:

(i) They are finger-like with very thin walls 

(ii) Provide a large surface area

(iii) Have small pores for food to pass

(iv) Richly supplied by blood capillaries

Which option/options shows/show the features that enable the villi to absorb food?
solution:
The correct answer is __(i), (ii), and (iv)__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Villi present in the small intestines of humans are finger-like projections having very thin walls with a rich supply of blood vessels.
 
• Villi provide a larger surface area in the inner lining of the small intestine and helps in larger absorption of nutrients with the increase in surface area.
 
• Villi is richly supplied with blood capillaries that helps in the absorption of digested food and carrying it to the blood stream.
